concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-online-banking-czech-republic-android-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15-captured Czech online banking Android Drop-in Sessions/Advanced add-on for no method-specific request fields, optional submit-button visibility, redirect prerequisite and test/live guidance.
warnings: No additional /sessions or /payments parameters is scoped to this Android Drop-in add-on; the API-only guide separately describes merchant-side bank issuer selection and example fields.
Real payment details and small amounts are test instructions in the captured source, not evidence of an executed payment or current account enablement.
